name: SOC 2
fullName: 2017 Trust Services Criteria for Security, Availability, Processing Integrity, Confidentiality, and Privacy (With Revised Points of Focus — 2022) (TSP Section 100)
publisher: AICPA (American Institute of Certified Public Accountants)
appliesTo: Service organisations that undergo a SOC 2 examination by a CPA firm, typically at the request of customers relying on their systems.
note: Titles are brief paraphrases of AICPA criteria (not criteria text); mapping indicates common controls that commonly support a criterion, not that they satisfy it — the auditor tests the organisation's own control description and points of focus.
